name: SVID
description: SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document issued by SPIRE to attest workload identity.

fields.name: spiffe_id
fields.description: The SPIFFE ID URI encoded in the SVID (e.g., spiffe://example.org/workload/frontend).

fields.name: hint
fields.description: Optional hint to distinguish between multiple SVIDs when a workload has more than one matching entry.

fields.name: x509_svid
fields.description: X.509-SVID payload — present when type is x509.

fields.name: cert_chain
fields.description: Ordered list of DER-encoded (base64) X.509 certificates from leaf to last intermediate.

fields.name: private_key
fields.description: DER-encoded (base64) private key. Delivered only by the Workload API.

fields.name: expiry_time
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the X.509-SVID expires.

fields.name: jwt_svid
fields.description: JWT-SVID payload — present when type is jwt.

fields.name: expiry_time
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the JWT-SVID expires.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the JWT-SVID was issued.
